Meaning or example: Legend drawn as a drafting view
New, existing, demolished and temporary elements: Working and checking views (new By category, existing Overridden, demolished Overridden, temporary Overridden)

The building as it stands at the end of the view's phase: Existing conditions (view phase EX), the finished building (new By category, existing By category, demolished Not displayed, temporary Not displayed)
Only what is built in the view's phase: Schedules and quantities of new work (new By category, existing Not displayed, demolished Not displayed, temporary Not displayed)
Existing and demolished elements: Demolition plans (009-PLAN-DEMO) (new Not displayed, existing Overridden, demolished Overridden, temporary Not displayed)
What stays, and what is new: Plans of a renovation; the default for every other view (new By category, existing Overridden, demolished Not displayed, temporary Not displayed)

Existing elements that stay, without demolished or new ones: Existing-to-remain plans for coordination and the owner's records (new Not displayed, existing By category, demolished Not displayed, temporary Not displayed)
Demolished and new, without what stays: Nothing: a plan without the walls that stay reads wrong
Elements of the phase before the view's: Nothing: shows nothing in the first phase, and Show Complete in a view of the earlier phase does the job
